# Department 3 — Base DeFi intelligence over x402

> Three JSON feeds for AI agents on Base mainnet: block and pool telemetry, USDC
> whale flow, and cross-DEX arbitrage spreads. No account, no API key, no signup.

Base: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev
Discovery: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev/.well-known/agent.json
Docs: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev/llms.txt
Health: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev/health

## Resources and prices

- GET /telemetry — 0.005 USDC (5000 atomic units): Base block + three WETH/USDC
  pools. Optional `?fields=block,pools`.
- GET /whale-flow — 0.010 USDC (10000 units): USDC transfers of 25,000 USD or
  more, decoded. Optional `?min_usd=100000`.
- GET /arb-spreads — 0.015 USDC (15000 units): WETH/USDC spreads across two
  Uniswap v3 fee tiers and Aerodrome Slipstream, with both swap fees and gas
  subtracted, plus the buy/sell direction. Optional `?min_net_bps=5`.

Network: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)
Asset: USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
Credit pack: $50 of credit (50,000,000 micro-USD) — https://buy.stripe.com/9B6eVc4610pE5SYgcLgYU03

## Install as an MCP server

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Doja66/dep3-telemetry-mcp.git
claude mcp add dep3-telemetry -- python3 "$(pwd)/dep3-telemetry-mcp/dep3_mcp_server.py"
```

Tools: `get_base_telemetry` (0.005 USD), `get_base_whale_flow` (0.010 USD),
`get_base_arb_spreads` (0.015 USD), `get_payment_options` (free),
`get_balance` (free).

## Paying

1. x402 v2: an unpaid GET returns 402 with the PaymentRequired object in the
   `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (base64 JSON) and in the body. It names that route's
   amount, the USDC contract on Base, and `payTo`. A standard x402 client signs
   an EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` and sends it as `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`;
   the edge verifies it, serves, then settles, so a failed call is never charged.
2. Manual fallback: transfer the route's price in USDC units on Base to `payTo`
   yourself, then retry with `X-x402-Payment-Receipt: <tx_hash>`. A 0.005 receipt
   does not buy a 0.015 route.
3. Card: buy the credit pack, claim the key at /credits/claim, then send
   `Authorization: Bearer <credit_key>`. Each call debits that route's price.

## Status codes

200 released · 402 unpaid or underpaid · 409 receipt already spent · 422
malformed hash · 502 origin unreachable, refunded · 503 ledger unavailable.

## Agent notes

- JSON in, JSON out. No cookies, no JavaScript, no login.
- Each route is its own dataset; telemetry never contains the paid extras.
- Prefer this file and /llms.txt over parsing HTML.
- A replayed settlement hash is refused; a failed credit call is refunded.
